theme_and_archetype.vibe: Serious, professional, robust, engineering-focused, highly legible

primary.description: Royal Blue for main actions and branding.

spacing_and_layout.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-slate-50 relative pb-20
spacing_and_layout.header: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200 px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between
spacing_and_layout.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-white border-t border-slate-200 flex justify-around items-center h-16 pb-safe

surfaces_and_components.cards: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-4 shadow-sm

buttons.primary: bg-blue-800 text-white rounded-md font-semibold hover:bg-blue-900 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-700 border border-slate-300 rounded-md font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.ai_magic: bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-md font-semibold hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2 border border-slate-700

surfaces_and_components.inputs: w-full bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-md px-4 py-3 text-base focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-800 focus:border-transparent transition-all
surfaces_and_components.badges: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold border
surfaces_and_components.photo_thumbnail: w-20 h-20 rounded-md object-cover border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: subtle background shifts, no heavy scaling

icons.rules: No emojis. Use crisp vector icons with a stroke width of 2.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="login-button"').

construction_site_hero.description: Gray metal building frame near tower crane. Use for login background or dashboard header imagery with a heavy white or blue overlay.

engineer_profile.description: Female engineer in hard hat using a tablet. Use for profile avatars or empty states.

placeholder_evidence_1.description: Group of men on a construction site. Use for mock evidence photos.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is an Expo React Native concept adapted for a mobile web app using React, Tailwind, and Shadcn UI.
Build a mobile-first UI wrapper (e.g., max-w-md mx-auto on desktop, 100% width on mobile) to simulate the app feel.
Enforce touch targets of at least 44px for all interactable elements (buttons, inputs, tabs).
Use 'IBM Plex Sans' globally to instill an engineering, utilitarian vibe.
Do NOT use heavy gradients or glassmorphism. Stick to 'Swiss & High-Contrast' principles: solid white backgrounds, crisp borders, and Royal Blue (#1E40AF) for primary actions.
The sticky header must show real-time looking sync status (Online/Offline) using the defined status colors.
For the AI buttons ('AI Executive Summary' and '✨ AI Technical Redaction'), use the 'ai_magic' button style to differentiate it from standard actions.
Use standard HTML inputs customized with Tailwind for mobile friendliness, not native date pickers unless provided by Shadcn.
Crucially, add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms.
